review.uiaReader: Byte-identical to original capture Read-UIA function; traversal order, fields, depth and child bounds preserved.
review.parentIsolation: Parent entry has no UIAutomation assembly, AutomationElement, Read-UIA or live UIA type references; JSON scalar validation is the only boundary.
review.targetOwnership: Worker rechecks PID, executable path, UTC start, HWND-to-PID mapping, non-exited state, lock owner and non-foreground target/worker before root acquisition, before traversal and after traversal.
review.naturalExit: Parent requires WaitForExit then retained process-handle WaitForSingleObject result 0 before cleanup; proof requires exit code 0, pre-cleanup kernel 0, already-signaled cleanup, no kill and empty primary/stream errors.
review.rawStreams: Parent waits for both raw copies, closes and seals destinations, measures hashes, validates exact stdout/stderr pair, then validates UIA bytes and returns. Caller cannot receive a successful result before this sequence completes.
review.boundedCleanup: Worker exit is bounded at 15 seconds; copy and each destination closure are bounded at 5 seconds; failed/timeout cleanup cannot qualify snapshot. Original capture helper bytes are retained unchanged.
review.backgroundAndActivation: Worker makes no activation/window/input calls; target or worker foreground state aborts; lock and target guards bracket each UIA phase.
review.integrationBoundary: Packet is an isolated source recipe. No production capture caller is changed or included, so pixel and WM_CLOSE ordering is specified for future caller integration, not demonstrated by this packet.
review.nativeBoundary: No Windows/native execution was performed or claimed.
